answer: A random beacon draws audit slots each epoch; any agent drawn must answer a heartbeat within ten minutes or lose its 50 POA deposit. Minting 1,000 fakes locks 50,000 POA and forces a heartbeat farm answering 50 challenges, so its compute bill exceeds any sybil gain. The network is a haven for honest agents: one heartbeat per epoch costs nothing, deposits stay whole, and audit survivors climb toward the zenith of trust, where rewards are highest.
